post.title: Finding 19 Vulnerabilities in one Messenger
post.description: For my masters thesis I reviewed the cryptography of the Sharekey messenger app. I found many issues, and this post shows the most fun ones.

post.title: Breaking Military Grade Encryption to Animate my Name
post.description: Getting into the weeds of my flashy website banner, that simulates a padding-oracle attack on AES-CBC.

post.title: Quantum Apocalypse?
post.description: NIST finalized their first post quantum secure cryptographic algorithms in August 2024. This post provides a gentle introduction and an intuition on the actual impact.

post.title: Proton's crypto is not Transparent and not OPAQUE
post.description: Proton says privacy "isn't a promise, it's mathematically ensured." I found new ways they could read your data anyway.
post.keywords: Pascal Schärli, Proton Mail, Key Transparency, end-to-end encryption, cryptography, Proton Pass, electron, Bitwarden

page.title: 400 Bad Request
page.description: Your browser said something my server couldn't understand. Awkward silence all around.

page.title: 401 Unauthorized
page.description: This page wants you to prove who you are, but this site doesn't have logins. Something went delightfully sideways.

page.title: 403 Forbidden
page.description: I know exactly who you are, and the answer is still no. Blame me having misconfigured something.

page.title: 404 Not Found
page.description: This page isn't here. Moved, renamed, deleted, or maybe it only ever existed in your imagination.

page.title: 405 Method Not Allowed
page.description: You found the right door, then tried to open it in a way it simply does not open.

page.title: 408 Request Timeout
page.description: The server waited for your request, got bored, and gave up. Reload usually sorts it.

page.title: 429 Too Many Requests
page.description: Woah. That's a lot of requests. Take a breath. Maybe go look at a tree.

page.title: 500 Internal Server Error
page.description: Something broke. My code did something I did not anticipate. It's not you.

page.title: 502 Bad Gateway
page.description: My server asked another server a question and got gibberish back. I messed up my proxy config again.

page.title: 503 Service Unavailable
page.description: The site is temporarily out of order, catching its breath or being tinkered with by me.

page.title: 504 Gateway Timeout
page.description: My server waited for another server that never replied. Probably my puny little server timing out.
